Name: Sign Language - Furniture Framework
Author: x7eventy7
Description:
[size=4][font=Tahoma][img]https://i.imgur.com/BLupZwo.png[/img]﻿
Elevate your farm's organization and aesthetics with three brand new catalogues available from Robin at the Carpenter's Shop! This mod introduces three unique catalogues featuring dark, wood, and stone signs, each designed to support 40 distinct characters from the English language. Now you can display A-Z and 0-9, along with four directional arrow signs. Personalize your farm by spelling out its name, or keep your farm organized by clearly labeling sheds, coops, barns, and more. Use the arrow signs to designate pathways, guide visitors, or label specific areas on your farm. The opportunities are limitless! Whether you're enhancing your farm's functionality or adding a personal touch, these signs are perfect for any project.
[/font][font=Tahoma]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wbISYFz.png[/img]﻿
